visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair wearing a white t-shirt stands in front of a wooden door. She holds her left hand out and applies a thick black balm with a small white spatula, smiling widely at the camera. (2) She holds up a round black container with 'DUO' written in gold, gesturing towards it with her index finger while maintaining a cheerful expression. The background is a brightly lit indoor hallway. (3) A close-up shows the container open on a marble surface. The black balm has a swirled texture. The woman uses the small white spatula to scoop out a small portion of the product. (4) The woman massages the black balm onto her right cheek in a circular motion. The balm turns into a grayish film on her skin. She smiles and looks directly into the lens. (5) She continues to massage the product over her entire face, including her eyes and lips. White sparkle graphics appear near her face as she demonstrates the application. (6) She wipes her face with a soft black towel. The screen then shows her face completely clean and glowing, with her skin looking smooth. She touches her cheek with one finger to show its texture. (7) She holds the DUO container again, gesturing towards it. Then, four other colored containers (yellow, red, blue, green) appear as digital overlays above her head. (8) Finally, she holds the black container and a spatula, pointing to a text overlay indicating a group buy period, and gives a thumbs-up and a playful wink.
